markets.name: Lamberton Farmers Market
markets.about: Locally grown produce from A to Zucchini, along with standard and specialty jams, jellies, and marmalade's; all kinds of pickled goodies, an array of salsa's from mild to hot; baked goods, cut flowers, and so much more! Come shop with us June through October, Thursdays, 3.30-6pm.
